purpose: Define approval gates and operational limits for irreversible actions in the agentic runtime

approval_gates.rule: read-only or dry-run by default; write requires mode=approval_required or explicit file_patch_apply_approval_required tool
only in dedicated promotion fronts; report-only fronts never patch source
only in dedicated test-fix fronts; must pass CI before baseline update
require human review; no auto-commit by agent without explicit front
normal push only; no force push, force-with-lease, or amend
candidate -> validated -> human approved -> promoted -> retrieval tested
separate front required; no runtime-triggered rebuild
new write/broker/trading tools require separate risk-governance front
must be documented and reviewed; no hidden fallback to expensive model
explicit approval; logged in decision journal
explicitly forbidden without separate risk-governance front
read-only/dry-run allowed; write/stateful calls require approval
opt-in only; operator must approve and configure endpoint
only after all gates pass and a separate front is accepted; human approval required

operational_limits.emergency_stop_rule: Operator can stop any run by unsetting AGENT_V2_BACKEND or restarting the server; fallback to Native is automatic.
operational_limits.failure_loudness_rule: No silent fallback unless explicitly recorded in backend_fallback_used and backend_fallback_reason. All failures must emit a trace event and set run status to failed with a reason.
